name: Xian
literature_vertical_cm_per_yr: Up to -13 cm/yr in 1990s, ~-5 cm/yr (2005-2012 InSAR), slowing or rebounding (+2 cm/yr) after groundwater controls (Qu et al., 2014; Zhang et al., 2018)
literature_sources: Qu, F. et al. (2014), Land subsidence and ground fissures in Xi'an from multi-band InSAR
Zhang, Y. et al. (2018), Evolution of subsidence and rebound in Xi'an
agreement_note: Consistent with moderated modern rates: 120-day NISAR peak (-1.5 cm LOS, -2.0 cm vertical est., -1.2 cm/100d) reflects residual localized settling after groundwater regulation. Low valid-pixel fraction (36.2%) and reference sensitivity [-3.9, -1.5] cm place confidence at low.
press_summary_gate_note: Kept indicative_only due to 36.2% valid pixels and reference spread [-3.9, -1.5] cm.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
